offer_summary: Acme Widgets is a time-tracking tool sold to marketing agencies on monthly plans from $49, positioned as a replacement for manual timesheets.

offer_sources.quote: Acme Widgets helps marketing agencies track billable hours automatically

positioning_drift.summary: Older copy sold Acme Widgets as a general project management tool for freelancers; today it is sold only to agencies.

sources.quote: Acme Widgets used to be a general project management tool for freelancers and small teams

personas.label: Agency owner
personas.needs: Needs proof that time tracking replaces manual timesheets before switching.

personas.label: Solo marketer
personas.needs: Needs a plan under $50 a month with no seat minimums.

dealbreakers.claim: There isn't yet public proof that Acme Widgets reduces admin time, only that it automates tracking.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: Show me hours saved, not just an automation feature list.

fix.action: Publish a dated case study with before/after hours saved.

dealbreakers.claim: Without a published case study, an agency owner has to take the time-savings claim on faith.
dealbreakers.detail: No dated before/after figures appear anywhere on the public pages.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: Where is the evidence this beats a spreadsheet?
dealbreakers.reason: No dated before/after data is shown anywhere on the public pages.

fix.action: Add a results page with named clients and figures.

dealbreakers.claim: Enterprise pricing is hidden behind a sales call.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: What does the Enterprise plan actually cost?

sources.quote: Enterprise pricing is available on request

fix.action: Publish an indicative Enterprise price band.

dealbreakers.claim: A 21-person agency has to jump straight to a sales conversation once seats run out.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: What happens once we pass 20 seats?

sources.quote: Growth plan is $99 per month for up to 20 seats

fix.action: List the per-seat rate above 20 seats.

dealbreakers.claim: Refunds are capped at 14 days, which may not cover a full onboarding cycle.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: What if onboarding takes longer than two weeks to show value?

sources.quote: Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase

fix.action: Extend or clarify the refund window relative to onboarding time.

dealbreakers.claim: A buyer cannot verify what happens to their data if they cancel.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: Is our data deleted or exported when we cancel?

fix.action: Add a data retention and export line to the security page.

dealbreakers.claim: It's unclear whether Acme Widgets still serves freelancers or has moved upmarket to agencies only.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: Is this still for a solo freelancer, or agencies only now?

sources.quote: Not for freelancers who only need a simple stopwatch app
Acme Widgets used to be a general project management tool for freelancers and small teams

fix.action: Retire or update the old freelancer-facing copy so it matches today's offer.

dealbreakers.claim: Switching from spreadsheets may mean re-entering every active client project by hand.
dealbreakers.detail: No migration or import tool is mentioned on any page.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: Can we import our existing client and project list?
dealbreakers.reason: No migration or import tool is mentioned on any page.

fix.action: Ship a CSV import for clients and projects.

dealbreakers.claim: A buyer cannot verify response times for support tickets.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: How fast do you respond to a support ticket?

fix.action: Add a stated support response time to the FAQ.

dealbreakers.claim: A review on reviews.example.org says onboarding ran longer than the sales team promised.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: How long does onboarding actually take?

sources.quote: onboarding took two weeks longer than the sales team promised

dealbreakers.claim: Acme Widgets explicitly excludes freelancers who only need a simple stopwatch.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: Is this too much tool for a one-person shop?

sources.quote: Not for freelancers who only need a simple stopwatch app

dealbreakers.claim: A buyer cannot verify whether Acme Widgets supports non-agency service businesses.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: Does this work for a consulting firm, not just an agency?

fix.action: Add a line on which service-business types Acme Widgets suits.

dealbreakers.claim: There's no quantified before/after for hours saved.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: Show me the actual reduction in hours logged, not just 'automatic tracking'.

fix.action: Publish a before/after hours-logged chart from real accounts.

dealbreakers.claim: SOC 2 status is stated as not-yet, with no target date given.
dealbreakers.buyer_question: Which security certifications do you actually hold today?

fix.action: Publish a security page with a certification roadmap and date.

handled.objection: Do they lock you into an annual contract?
handled.how: Plans are billed monthly with no lock-in mentioned anywhere.

not_prioritised: Generic 'is this another subscription' objections are left off: the pricing page already lists monthly plans with no lock-in.
